fireside.speaker: A person, maybe 40s, with a broad frame
fireside.text: "Stone. We need 52 more for the palisade footings. Creek beds, hillsides — pry it loose."

fireside.speaker: Tariq
fireside.text: "171 wood. We need 350. The forest isn't going to cut itself."

fireside.speaker: Theo
fireside.text: "249 wood. We need 350. The forest isn't going to cut itself."

fireside.speaker: Nikolai
fireside.text: "The granary wants food that WAITS — 0 of 2,000 kcal preserved. Smoke it, dry it, render it. The fresh stuff doesn't count."

fireside.speaker: Chantal
fireside.text: "It eats while we deliberate. The Herald feeds on our stores and we're supposed to just... wait?"

fireside.speaker: Gilberto
fireside.text: "Why them? ...Sorry. It's just sitting there, and they're the one who has to sit in it."

fireside.speaker: Renzo
fireside.text: "Why them? ...Sorry. It's just sitting there, and they're the one who has to sit in it."

fireside.speaker: Maya
fireside.text: "The table's set. The ring of pale light — it's just sitting there. Waiting on them. What do you think they'll tell it?"

fireside.speaker: Rosa
fireside.text: "Nobody's sleeping. The sky is waiting and nobody knows what to do with their hands."

fireside.speaker: Gilberto
fireside.text: "Nobody's sleeping. The sky is waiting and nobody knows what to do with their hands."

fireside.speaker: Chantal
fireside.text: "Did you see their faces? Too many angles. I keep wondering what they want from us."

fireside.speaker: Rosa
fireside.text: "It waits. We wait. Somebody should check the snares — the table doesn't fill the pantry."

tableLines.line: Deeper knowledge: Burdock. Uses: starchy root vegetable. Dig first-year plants (no flower stalk). (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: first-year roots only — dig deep, peel, cook like carrots; medicine: root tea, traditional blood purifier; fiber: tough stalk fiber for rough cordage.
